proposals.title: REPORT ON EFFECTIVENESS OF SOCIAL COMPLIANCE EFFORTS IN TJX'S SUPPLY CHAIN
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan and the Sisters of St. Dominic
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party assessment and report on the effectiveness of TJX's due diligence in preventing forced, child, and prison labor in its supply chain.
proposals.evidence: your Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: REPORT ON RISK TO TJX FROM SUPPLIER MISCLASSIFICATION OF SUPPLIER'S EMPLOYEES
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on financial, reputational, and human rights risks from supply chain and distribution companies misclassifying employees as independent contractors.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 6.

proposals.title: PAID SICK LEAVE POLICY FOR ALL ASSOCIATES
proposals.proponent: Figure 8 Investment Strategies, on behalf of the Revocable Trust of Ellen E. Bush
proposals.topic_summary: Requests adoption and public disclosure of a paid sick leave policy for all part- and full-time employees, not expiring or dependent on a pandemic.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 7.
